name: stockpilot-wms
description: StockPilot WMS — Enterprise Warehouse Management System

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=backend && npm run typecheck --workspace=frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=backend && npm run lint --workspace=frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=frontend && rm -rf dist && cp -r frontend/dist ./dist
scripts.build:pages: npm run build --workspace=frontend && rm -rf dist && cp -r frontend/dist ./dist
scripts.deploy: npm run build:pages && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name stockpilot-wms
